title: A reading list for karyakartas
author: Editorial Desk
summary: Ten places to start for anyone who wants to understand BMS and Indian labour.
body:
Here is a short list of reading sources, with reminders to check each one yourself.

1. **Dattopant Thengadi Archive** (dbthengadi.in): life, writings and photographs.
2. **The Onward March of BMS**: a history of the organisation's early decades.
3. ***Consumer: A Sovereign without Sovereignty*** by Thengadi Ji, on consumers' rights.
4. **BMS website** (bms.org.in): news, resolutions and publications.
5. **Ministry of Labour & Employment** (labour.gov.in): Acts, Codes and notifications.
6. **India Code** (indiacode.nic.in): authoritative text of laws.
7. **PRS Legislative Research**: summaries of Bills and Codes.
8. **ILO** (ilo.org): standards, reports and data.
9. **V.V. Giri National Labour Institute**: research and training.
10. **Constitution of India**: Articles 19, 23, 24, 39, 41, 42, 43 and 43A.

## How to read

Start with the original text. Read commentary afterward. Note the date of what you read, since labour law changes.

## Share your suggestions

If a book or paper helped you, tell us. We will add it to the Downloads page of this website.
